correctness.rationale: In the projective generator model, a column is zero on U exactly when its vector lies in W=U-perp. If a=dim(W intersect V1) and b=dim(W intersect V2), the support formula is q^k-q^(k-r)-q^k1-q^k2+q^a+q^b. Grassmann dimension inequalities give a>=max(0,k1-r) and b>=max(0,k2-r), so the minimizers are exactly simultaneous equality cases. Fixing the two intersections A,B, the quotient W/(A direct-sum B) meets both coordinate summands trivially and hence is uniquely the graph of an isomorphism T:X->Y between c_r-dimensional subspaces. Counting A,B,X,Y,T gives the formula bijectively. An independent arithmetic recomputation reproduced the packaged sample multiplicities (21,42,42,21,1) over F_2 and (104,624,624,104,1) over F_3; the general proof is linear-algebraic rather than experimental.
